data.title: Tokyo hosts second round of US-Myanmar talks
data.description: TOKYO - Representatives of the United States and Myanmar’s military-backed government held talks in Tokyo last week, people familiar with ​the matter said, their second meeting in a month as Washington steps up re-engagement with the generals it ‌shunned after their 2021 coup.

data.title: ONE Championship: Johan Ghazali open to Ondash rematch after settling Paez score
data.description: Johan Ghazali has left the door open to another fight with Ramadan Ondash in ONE Championship after avenging his defeat by Diego Paez – while reviving his complaint about the Lebanese fighter’s mouthguard.

data.title: ONE Championship: Rukiya Anpo says Samurai 4 fight is off after ninth failed hydration test
data.description: Rukiya Anpo says his fight against Bogdan Shumarov is off ONE Samurai 4 after a ninth failed hydration test on Saturday morning, leaving the Tokyo event without two of its highest-profile kickboxing bouts.

data.title: ONE Championship: Marat Grigorian into final after Luo Chao’s 9.4lb miss – ‘he just didn’t care’
data.description: Marat Grigorian has advanced to the ONE Samurai featherweight kickboxing tournament final after Luo Chao’s extraordinary 9.4lb weight miss, accusing his opponent of failing to take the cut seriously.

data.title: Haze triggers highest-level alert in parts of Southeast Asia
data.description: SINGAPORE - Fires in Indonesia that have sent toxic smoke disrupting daily life across Southeast Asia has triggered the highest-level alert by the regional bloc’s meteorological monitor.

data.title: Trump waives key Russia-related sanctions and tariffs
data.description: WASHINGTON - President Donald Trump has waived key Russia-related US sanctions and tariffs days before they were to take effect under a law he signed last month, including duties on the country’s goods and penalties for buying its oil and gas.

data.title: Questions mount over gambling site and MP’s husband
data.description: Former Democrat MP Sirichok Sopha is demanding a deeper investigation into the blocking of the crypto gambling website Shuffle.com and the role played in the business by the husband of Bhumjaithai MP Suchada Zhang Thaensap.

data.title: IMF chief to take King Bhumibol’s teachings to Washington after Bangkok meetings
data.description: IMF chief Kristalina Georgieva praises Thailand’s progress over 35 years and hospitality as the country hosts the 2026 IMF–World Bank meetings

data.title: Chinese fugitive ‘oversaw mule accounts worth B2.5 billion’
data.description: Thai police have arrested a Chinese fugitive in Bangkok for allegedly managing mule accounts that circulated over 500 million yuan and arranging visas for members of transnational criminal gangs.

data.title: Minister apologises over e-harvester price blunder
data.description: Agriculture and Cooperatives Minister Suriya Juangroongruangkit has apologised for mistakenly quoting a price of 16 million baht each for electric rice harvesters, insisting the ministry has no plans to buy the machines.

data.title: Academic asks why BMA overlooked flood projects
data.description: A Kasetsart University academic has questioned why Bangkok allocated more than 34 billion baht to flood prevention over two years while omitting six major eastern water-retention projects from its action plans.

data.title: THAI opens compensation site for flood-hit passengers
data.description: Thai Airways International has approved compensation measures for passengers affected by flight delays, cancellations and delayed baggage caused by heavy rain and flooding between Sept 26 and 30.

data.title: Government urged to rethink ‘sin tax’ allocations
data.description: Movendi International has urged Thailand to abandon plans to scrap its earmarked tax system, warning that the move could expose public health policies to political interference and pressure from the alcohol and tobacco industries.

data.title: Promised China trip never booked, 45 students stranded at airport
data.description: An investigation has been ordered after 45 Thai students were stranded at Suvarnabhumi Airport after being promised a field trip to China, only to learn there were no flight tickets for them on the departure date.

data.title: Rights groups decry IMF austerity demand
data.description: Coconut farmer Sombat Chuekrod travelled more than 200 kilometres to join hundreds on the streets of Bangkok on Friday demanding that the International Monetary Fund and World Bank change how they deal with the developing world.

data.title: Flood woes test People’s Party
data.description: The devastating floods that paralysed large parts of Bangkok have revived a familiar but consequential question in Thai politics: What exactly do voters expect from their elected MPs when a crisis strikes?

data.title: Earn Attention, Don't Fight for It: Netflix and Music Chiefs on Asia's Creative Boom
data.description: At CNN's Bangkok forum, Netflix and Pacific Music Group leaders say local authenticity, not global chasing, is turning Asian talent into worldwide influence

data.title: Fiji village restores dying fishery with coral planting
data.description: NAIDIRI - It had been decades since sharks last patrolled the reef off the coast of Fiji’s Naidiri Village, but they returned this year following a community-led effort to protect the fishery and plant thousands of corals.

data.title: Japan reports record number of foreign residents
data.description: TOKYO - Japan has registered a record number of foreigners living in the country this year despite growing anti-immigration sentiment, as the country grapples with problems caused by an ageing and shrinking population.

data.title: North Korea reports test of AI-assisted torpedo system
data.description: SEOUL - North Korea has tested a “new-type” precision-guided torpedo system that uses artificial intelligence for target detection and guidance, state media reported on Saturday, as the nuclear-armed country steps up weapons testing.

data.title: UN climate panel fails to agree date for global warming update
data.description: PARIS - The UN's IPCC climate panel failed after a week of tough talks to reach an agreement on when to release its next report on global warming, the senior French envoy at the talks said Friday.

data.title: What Thailand Can Learn from the K-Pop Film that Conquered the World

data.title: Korn urges govt to take action on scams
data.description: Democrat Party deputy leader Korn Chatikavanij has urged the government to step up its fight against scam networks, warning that international cooperation means little without action at home.

data.title: Cumbia comin' on strong
data.description: On the website of the Baltimore-based cumbia band Soroche is a big caps statement, "Cumbia Is The New Punk". This cumbia "fusion" outfit mixes cumbia, punk, ska, folk, a bit of rock'n'roll and anything else that takes their fancy into a heady Tropical concoction, or as the band puts it, "a danceable alchemy that crosses cultural dancefloors".
